newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Noble Drilling started neutral. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Noble Drilling started neutral. [CORRECTED 15:40 GMT]

text.p: Dillon Read & Co Inc said analyst Byron Dunn (corrects from Michael Villarreal) started coverage of Noble Drilling Corp with a neutral rating Thursday.
-- expects shares of the drilling services provider to trade to $30 a share range by year-end 1997.

-- sees 1997 and 1998 EPS of $1.11 and $1.90 a share, respectively. Estimates cash flow per share at $1.78 for 1997 and $2.61 for 1998. Sees 1997 total revenue of $771 million and EBITDA of $285 million.
-- says company is increasing its exposure to deeper water drilling by converting submersible rigs to semisubmersible configureation and buying premium deepwater rigs.
